jobs.description:
SEE ENGLISH VERSION BELOW

Viking Gulvservice er en veletableret virksomhed beliggende i Københavns området, som gennem årene har leveret professionelle malerydelser til en bred vifte af kundetyper. Udover gulvarbejde tilbyder vi også tømrer- og malerarbejde.

Vi søger netop nu 1-2 erfarne kollegaer til vores tømrerteam, som kan være med til at løse virksomhedens opgaveportefølje.

Har du erfaring som tømrer og er du passioneret omkring dit arbejde, så kan vi tilbyde dig en attraktiv arbejdsplads med højt humør!

 

Om jobbet:

Hos Viking Gulvservice kommer du til at arbejde med række forskellige tømreropgave, bl.a. opbygning af gulvkonstruktioner, montering af gipsplader, opbygning af lettere trækonstruktioner m.m.

Du vil blive tilknyttet en kollega, så I altid er to om opgaverne, ved små opgaver må man forvente at arbejde selvstændigt. Som makkerpar får I stillet en firmabil til rådighed med de nødvendige maskiner og værktøj.

Vi forventer, at du:

1.       Har minimum 1 års erfaring indenfor tømrerfaget

2.       Har kørekort B

3.       Er pligtopfyldende og letforståelig på engelsk eller dansk

4.       Afslutter en opgave ryddelig og kvalitetsbevidst

Vi tilbyder:

1.       Attraktiv løn

2.       Arbejdstid i tidsrummet 07:00-15:00

3.       Kollegaer du kan sparrer med

4.       Spændende og alsidige opgave

 

Lyder stillingen interessant, eller har du spørgsmål? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på mail gm@vikinggulvservice.dk

Vi ser frem til din ansøgning og cv.

Samtaler afholdes løbende med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

ENGLISH:

Viking Gulvservice is a well-established company located in Ballerup. Over the years, we have provided professional painting services to a wide range of customers. In addition to flooring services, we also offer painting and carpentry services.

We are currently looking for 1–2 experienced colleagues to join our carpentry team and help us handle our growing portfolio of projects.

If you have experience as a carpenter and are passionate about your work, we can offer you an attractive workplace with a positive and friendly atmosphere.

 

About the job

At Viking Gulvservice, you will work on a variety of carpentry tasks, including building floor structures, installing plasterboard/drywall, constructing light timber structures, and other related carpentry work.

You will normally work together with a colleague, so there will usually be two of you assigned to each project. For smaller jobs, however, you should be comfortable working independently.

As a team, you will have access to a company vehicle equipped with the necessary machinery and tools.

We expect you to:

1.       Have at least 1 year of experience working as a carpenter

2.       Hold a valid Category B driving licence

3.       Be reliable, responsible and able to communicate in English or Danish

4.       Take pride in completing your work to a high standard and leaving the work area clean and tidy

We offer:

1.       Attractive salary

2.       Working hours between 07:00 and 15:00

3.       Supportive and experienced colleagues you can exchange knowledge with

4.       Exciting and varied carpentry projects

 

Does the position sound interesting, or do you have any questions?

You are very welcome to contact us by email at gm@vikinggulvservice.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and we are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

ristorante Amarone is looking for a skilled, reliable, and dedicated Cook to join our team.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Has relevant experience working as a cook

• 
Is skilled and passionate about preparing high-quality food

• 
Is reliable, responsible, and committed to their work

• 
Can work independently as well as part of a team

• 
Is flexible and able to work in a busy environment

We offer a full-time position in a professional and friendly workplace.

If you are an experienced and motivated cook looking for a new opportunity, we would be happy to hear from you.

The Impact You'll Make

As our Power Electronics Architect, you’ll play a key role in shaping the next generation of variable speed drive solutions within our HVAC and Water Drives business. By defining and driving the power electronics architecture of our frequency converters, you will develop more energy-efficient, reliable, and sustainable motor control solutions.

Your impact? You will define the technical direction of future drive platforms, ensuring optimal performance, cost competitiveness, reliability, and scalability. Your work will directly support our customers' efforts to improve energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact while accelerating the transition toward electrification. You’ll collaborate closely with experts across hardware, software, systems, mechanical engineering, supply chain, and procurement while taking ownership of the power electronics architecture and design principles that help us build innovative products for a more sustainable future.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Define and own the power electronics system architecture for next-generation variable speed drive products

• Drive technical decisions and trade-offs across performance, cost, manufacturability, and reliability

• Lead concept development and evaluation of emerging technologies ex. Silicon Carbide (SiC)

• Collaborate across hardware, software, systems, and mechanical teams to ensure alignment with product and customer requirements

• Mentor engineers, promote best practices, and contribute to platform development and long-term innovation initiatives

What We're Looking For

• Master's degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

• Extensive experience designing power electronic systems for frequency converters, drives, inverters, or similar applications

• Strong knowledge of converter topologies, power semiconductor technologies, and system-level architecture development

• Experience with simulation and modeling tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalent tools

• Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, combined with the ability to influence technical direction across multidisciplinary teams

• A team-oriented mindset and a genuine interest in contributing to a positive, supportive, and trust-based working environment where collaboration, well-being, and strong collegial relationships are valued

What You'll Get from Us

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Information at a Glance

Apply now

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

D’ANGLETERRE IS LOOKING FOR EXPERIENCED ON-CALL WAITERS FOR OUR RESTAURANT MARCHAL

Are you passionate about Michelin and luxury service? Do you want to be part of a motivated team with high ambitions in a privileged environment where you will develop and nurture successful working relationships, both with our guests and within your workplace? Then you might be the on-call waiter we are looking for to support our restaurant Marchal.

WE OFFER

An exciting working day in an international environment in our Michelin awarded restaurant Marchal. We are a young and dynamic team, who together delivers a personal, stylish and elegant service of the highest international standard. Through our internal d’Anglecademy you will be trained in various programs to give you best possible circumstances for growth and success.

ABOUT THE JOB

As an on call waiter at Marchal, you will elevate our guests by creating unforgettable experiences through a high level of service and your expertise within wines and Michelin cuisine. You will work closely with our team of dedicated waiters and chefs to ensure a flawless service at a Michelin level. You must maintain high guest loyalty throughout high guest satisfaction and ensure that all guests receive a unique and magical experience.

WE EXPECT

That you have similar experience as waiter in a Michelin star or a luxury establishment. You are detail-oriented and able to keep the grand overview, while being sincerely passionate and engaged with both guests and employees. You are a visible and active team member and ensure a good cooperation with the rest of the hotel. In other words with your professional skills and outgoing personality, we expect that you will be able to create unique relationships and experiences for our guests at any time.

You speak fluent English and maybe another language. Danish is a plus but not a must.

We are Playdead, an independent game company based in the heart of Copenhagen, Denmark. We have made two critically acclaimed titles, LIMBO and INSIDE. Our current project is a 3rd-person science fiction adventure set in a remote corner of the universe.

We are seeking an experienced Level Architect with strong artistic skills to join our team in Copenhagen. As our process is very visually driven, we expect layout artists to have a strong eye for visual composition and broad experience in the creation of 3D environments.

Your responsibility as our new colleague will be in designing, blocking out, and in some cases modeling locations for a third-person, open-world game. At Playdead, locations are often designed with a combination of grey-boxing and more detailed, modeled elements. You will work in coordination with the other designers and artists on the team with a focus on how the player will flow within the level and betweens spaces.

We are a close-knit group of developers, and working within that group requires an ability to adapt to the existing visual style and methods while contributing your own ideas to the whole. We are particularly looking for a candidate who enjoys setting their own goals and taking responsibility for their own schedule. More than anything, we are looking for someone who is excited about all facets of game development, as well as being passionate about gaming overall.

You should be willing to work at the Playdead office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Keywords for position

layout - level design - composition -3D - modelling - iteration

What will you be doing?

• Level layout, spatial design and composition using primitive blockouts and 3D assets to produce believable locations within a large, open world.

• Taking a basic brief and mocking up a grey box design to set the foundation for further development and visual storytelling.

• Detailed, untextured 3D modeling

• Iterating on existing location designs based on feedback and testing.

• Collaborating with other artists and designers to support level design and construction.

If you wish to apply, please consider the following general requirements

• You have worked on the development of at least one released 3D game.

• A link to an online portfolio of previous work showcasing a knowledge of composition, layout, lighting, colour and visual storytelling.

• Experience with a game engine such as Unity, Unreal etc. or an internal engine is a must.

• Experience with 3D packages such as Blender, Maya, 3dsMax, etc. is a strong advantage.

Desired skills

• Experience with world creation tools such as World Machine, Quadspinner Gaea, or similar is a plus.

Who We Are

We are a team of more than 100 creative professionals. We experiment and collaborate with a focus on creating new experiences, and as such we are looking for people who can help us achieve them.

Our approach to development does not include crunching towards arbitrary deadlines - instead, we particularly look for talented people who enjoy managing their own schedule and thrive on working within a friendly, collaborative environment.

We love to make carefully crafted games with obsessive attention to detail and are always on the lookout for others who share that passion.

At LLPOS, we build modern cloud-based point-of-sale systems for restaurants, cafés, and retailers across Denmark. We work with leading payment providers (Nets, Worldline, Softpay, Swedpay, Verifone, and MobilePay) - operating at the heart of the Nordic payments ecosystem. We're growing fast, and we're looking for a relentless hustler who wants to grow with us.

The best Customer Success Manager isn't the one who answers the most support calls. It's the one who ensures customers rarely need to call - and consistently helps them get more value from our platform.

The Role

You'll own the relationship with a portfolio of merchants, such as restaurant owners, café managers, retailers. This means not just replying to their support tickets, but:

• 
Understanding their business well enough to spot problems before they become support calls

• 
Reaching out proactively with relevant features, improvements, or ways to get more from the platform

• 
Handling support issues when they come up, but treating them as the exception, not the job

• 
Feeding what you learn from merchants back into the product

Success in this role = customers who rarely need to call, and who wouldn't consider switching providers.

What we're looking for

• 
Fluent written and spoken Danish (additional languages a plus)

• 
Comfortable having commercial conversations that feel like advice, not sales

• 
Able to work independently (this role has real autonomy and not a lot of hand-holding)

• 
Curious about technology and interested in fintech/payments

• 
Some experience in customer success, account management, or a similar client-facing role

We care more about how you work than your exact background. If you take initiative, follow through, and like fixing things rather than complaining about them, we want to hear from you.

You're not a fit if: you prefer clearly defined daily tasks and a manager who tells you what to do. That's a completely reasonable preference, it's just not how this team operates.

What you get

• 
Direct exposure to Nordic fintech: daily collaboration with Nets, Worldline, Softpay, Swedpay, Verifone, and MobilePay

• 
Real ownership: your customers, your calls, measured on outcomes rather than process

• 
Room to grow: we're early-stage and growing quickly, so responsibility comes fast

• 
A small, senior team: direct access to the people building the product, including a founding team with 50+ years of combined experience at major companies

For more information or questions please contact us at rk@lovingloyalty.com

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• ETL and Database technologies.

• Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

About the team 👥

Product Management at Performativ is responsible for deciding what we build, why we build it, and whether it delivers the intended result. We own the roadmap, shape the solution, make the trade-offs, and follow each product through to adoption.

We work directly with engineers and spend meaningful time with clients. There is no layer of process separating Product from the people building or using the platform.

We are a small team working across a large product surface: portfolio management, reporting, trading, compliance, client engagement, and the data and integrations that connect it all. Every roadmap decision comes with an opportunity cost. Our job is to make those decisions with conviction—and take responsibility for the outcome.

About the role 🎯

We are looking for a Domain Expert & Product Owner to help shape and own our wealth management platform and its underlying data layer.

This role sits at the intersection of financial-domain expertise, product management, and technology. You will help set product direction based on client needs, market understanding, and Performativ’s wider business goals. You will turn complex financial workflows into clear, reusable product capabilities that solve real problems without compromising the coherence of the platform.

The problems you might work on range from defining how Modified Dietz returns should be calculated and improving the performance of computational algorithms to reducing latency in trading workflows and designing interfaces used by thousands of advisers every day.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and engineers to shape features before and during implementation. That means creating workflows, prototypes, product logic, and concrete examples—not simply writing requirements and handing them over.

You will also act as a key internal domain expert across wealth management, portfolio management, investment advice, trading, compliance, and related workflows. You will support commercial and customer-facing teams when specialist product knowledge is required and work directly with clients to understand how new capabilities fit into their wider technology and operating environment.

You will own both the ultra visible and also the less visible, but equally important, parts of the platform, including reconciliation logic, corporate-action processing, valuations, and data quality. A central part of the job is distinguishing genuine product gaps from client-specific preferences or processes inherited from legacy systems.

You need enough technical depth to earn the trust of engineers and client architects, enough commercial judgement to understand the consequences of your decisions, and the confidence to challenge a request—even when there is revenue attached—if it would weaken the product.

The role is based in Copenhagen. We support relocation for the right candidate.

What you'll do 📈

• 
Shape product direction based on client needs, market developments, business priorities, and engineering capability.

• 
Translate complex financial and operational workflows into clear, reusable product solutions.

• 
Help own and prioritise the roadmap for Performativ’s Wealth Management Suite.

• 
Evaluate opportunities based on client value, product quality, business impact, and technical feasibility.

• 
Work closely with Product, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and engineers to shape features before and during implementation.

• 
Create workflows, prototypes, product logic, and concrete examples that help teams align around the problem and the proposed solution.

• 
Write clear specifications that Engineering can build from without repeatedly having to interpret the underlying intent.

• 
Join client meetings, deals, and technical discovery sessions, then translate what you learn into sound product decisions.

• 
Act as an internal domain expert and support customer-facing teams when specialist product or financial knowledge is required.

• 
Identify gaps and inconsistencies across the platform and improve the overall coherence of the product.

• 
Decide what we commit to, what we decline, and why - and communicate those decisions clearly.

• 
Work with Engineering to balance speed, cost, performance, and long-term architectural integrity.

• 
Follow features into production, measure adoption and outcomes, and be honest about what worked and what did not.

What we're looking for 🔍

• 
Substantial experience in asset management, wealth management, private banking, or a closely related financial domain. Ideally, experience from a middle-office, portfolio-management, investment-operations, advice, or trading environment.

• 
A good understanding of financial products, their underlying mathematical concepts, and their operational consequences.

• 
Experience or desire to own a meaningful product or process area. Not merely coordinating tasks or administering a backlog.

• 
The ability to understand how portfolio data moves through a financial institution and where operational or data-quality problems arise.

• 
Comfort working directly with engineers and discussing APIs, data models, system integrations, and technical trade-offs.

• 
A track record of turning vague, conflicting, or overly client-specific requirements into coherent product capabilities that were built and shipped.

• 
Strong product judgement and the confidence to challenge customers, executives, and engineers when necessary.

• 
The ability to explain complex topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Clear and precise writing. Much of your influence in this role will come through written decisions, examples, and specifications.

• 
Comfort making decisions with incomplete information and taking responsibility for the result.

• 
A willingness to travel across Europe for client work.

Preferred experience ➕

• 
Experience with portfolio-management systems or related order, execution, custody, or investment-management platforms.

• 
At least five years of meaningful product-management experience.

• 
Familiarity with financial-services regulation, such as MiFID II, EMIR, or Dodd-Frank.

• 
Hands-on software-engineering experience or a strong technical background.

• 
A practical and ambitious view of how AI can improve both your own work and the products we build.

• 
Experience replacing an incumbent system within a regulated institution such as a wealth manager, bank, asset manager, or custodian.

• 
Experience working in a high-growth or rapidly changing business.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Real ownership from day one. You will own outcomes, not simply administer a backlog. There are very few layers between you and a decision.

• 
Work that reaches production quickly. We ship continuously, and your work can be in the hands of advisers and financial institutions within days rather than quarters.

• 
Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team includes people from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon, and other ambitious organisations.

• 
The opportunity to grow through responsibility. People at Performativ take on meaningful scope quickly. If you demonstrate that you can carry it, we will give you more.

• 
Direct access to founders, clients, and the market. You will be part of the conversations in which important product and business decisions are made.

• 
An ambitious mandate. We are backed by leading venture and institutional investors and are building to become a European standard—not simply another regional alternative.

About Performativ 🚀

Much of wealth management still runs on software built for another era: batch files, overnight reconciliation, manually assembled reports, and disconnected systems. Advisers and operations teams spend too much of their time working around their technology rather than serving clients.

Performativ is replacing that infrastructure. We provide one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, built around how modern wealth managers actually operate. Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond.

We have raised more than USD 23 million from international venture-capital firms and leading European institutional investors. Our ambition is straightforward: to become the system on which wealth management runs.

You can learn more about our product at performativ.com.

The bar 🔥

We are builders. We move quickly, speak plainly, and expect people to take responsibility for their work. Autonomy is the default, but it only works when paired with strong judgement, initiative, and follow-through.

Performativ offers unusual scope for someone who wants to take on real responsibility and build something that matters. In two years, you should be able to point to important parts of the product and say: “I built that.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

Responsibilities and technologies

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Ensuring the quality of the solution through various types of testing

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting

About you

You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

• Can navigate complex error scenarios and understand complex system landscapes

• Are systematic and detail-oriented throughout the analysis, design, development, and testing phases

• Think logically and analytically, and can break down and understand complex concepts and communicate issues and gaps clearly and effectively

• Thrive on a methodical and structured approach to your work

• Hold a relevant master’s degree

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

What will you learn?

As a Crane Mechanic Apprentice, you will work with the construction, installation, troubleshooting and repair of truck-mounted cranes and truck chassis.

Modern cranes combine mechanics with advanced electrical, hydraulic and electronic systems, so two days are not quite the same.

During your apprenticeship, you will gain practical experience with:

• Hydraulic systems

• Electrical and electronic systems

• Control and monitoring systems

• Commissioning and calibration

• Safety inspections

You will also learn to use computers and specialist software for diagnostics, commissioning and calibration.

About the programme

The Crane Mechanic programme takes 4 years and combines school-based training with practical apprenticeship training in a company.

The programme starts with Basic Course 2, lasting 20 weeks. You then continue to the main course, where school periods at HEG alternate with practical training in your apprenticeship company.

At the end of the programme, you complete your final trade examination and become a qualified Crane Mechanic.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need to know everything from day one – that is what the apprenticeship is for.

We are looking for someone who:

• Has completed compulsory schooling (lower secondary education)

• Has a legal right to work on Denmark at the start of employment without the need for a work permit

jobs.occupation: Backend Developer, Data Collection and Infrastructure
jobs.description:
What we are building

Someone researching a purchase might start in ChatGPT, compare options in Perplexity, run a Google search, then go back to an AI assistant to decide. The companies being compared have little idea where they show up in that chain or what gets said about them, and very few can measure it today.

We build the infrastructure that measures it. Every platform we track changes under us, and none of them offers a feed, so we collect the data ourselves. The collection is the hard part, and it is most of this job. Three products run on it:

• AccuRanker is the rank tracking and SEO analytics platform. Rankings, competitor movement, keyword research, dashboards, forecasting.

• AccuLLM tracks brand visibility inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overview, and AI Mode.

• AccuSERP is a search data API we sell to other companies in the industry.

On a normal day that means 27 billion rows inserted, 85 million web requests collected, 80 million background jobs run, and 64 million analytical queries served. Eight people build and run all of it.

What you will work on

• The collection and ingestion pipeline behind those numbers, together with the engineers who run it today.

• Add coverage for new search surfaces as they appear, and fix the ones we already cover when they change shape.

• Write and tune queries against very large time series data, across columnar and relational stores.

• Start with scoped changes to existing services, and grow into owning services yourself, from design through deployment to how they behave in production.

What you bring

Must have:

• Solid programming fundamentals. You write clear code and can reason about what it costs at runtime.

• Code of yours running somewhere real. A production system at work, a service you host yourself, or a side project with actual users.

• Comfort in Linux. You can read logs, follow a request through a system, and find out why something is slow.

• Ownership. You take a problem, decide how to attack it, ask when you are stuck, and follow through.

Good to have:

• Distributed systems fundamentals. Queues, workers, backpressure, etc.

• Python and its common frameworks (Django, Celery, pandas/polars). Our stack runs mostly on Python, but it is not a must if the fundamentals are strong.

• ClickHouse or another columnar store.

• The network layer. Connection lifecycle, timeouts and retries, TLS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3.

• Web scraping or browser automation.

• AI agents. Tool and context design, structured output and evals.

• Kafka.

All of it can be learned here.

Who does well here

People who set a high standard for their own work, and who care about performance, reliability, cost, and operational simplicity.

You want to own a feature end to end, from idea to production. The problems we hand you will be scoped at first, and less so over time, and a month after something ships, you are still the one who cares about it.

You move fast when speed is what the problem needs, and you know when stability, safety and maintainability matter more.

This field moves fast right now. We expect you to read, try things, and form your own view of what is worth using, without waiting to be told what is new.

The job is wide. In one week you might tune a database, debug a proxy network, and design an agent.

This role is not for you if you want a narrow technical scope or a large team around you. We are small, the problems change, and you will get real responsibility earlier than most places give it. The senior engineers sit next to you, and asking them is part of the job.

AI at AccuRanker

AI is a big part of the product and of how we build it. AccuLLM sends queries to LLMs all day, customers use our MCP server, and agents and tool design are real engineering problems here.

Being effective with coding agents is becoming a core engineering skill, and it is part of this job. You should be good at giving agents the right context, breaking work into pieces they can execute well, reviewing what they produce, and knowing when to take over yourself. The bar is more high-quality engineering done without outsourcing your understanding and judgment, which is a different thing from using AI a lot.

How we work

• You own services, not tickets. You decide how to solve the problem, make the tradeoffs, and deploy it yourself.

• We ship many times a day. A change can go from idea to production the same day.

• We argue about designs, in writing and in the room. Correctness, cost, and latency are worth arguing about out loud.

• We share what we know and help each other own unfamiliar parts of the system.

What we offer

• Salary set individually on skills and experience.

• Pension, health insurance, flexible working hours, and paid parental leave.

• Hardware of your choosing.

• Office in central Aarhus on Åboulevarden, top floors, panoramic views over the city. The role is on-site, with hybrid options planned for later this year.

• Great lunch.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note to pet@accuranker.com, in Danish or English. A link to something you have built counts for a lot.

We review applications as they come in and hire as soon as we find the right person, so send yours when it is ready.

Questions about the role are welcome. Call our CTO, Peter Emil Tybirk, on +45 61 41 77 41.

Experience working with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) is also an advantage.

You combine strong technical expertise with the credibility and confidence to influence decisions across a complex project organization. You are comfortable challenging solutions when safety requirements are at stake and thrive in a role where you can take ownership, drive initiatives, and lead through expertise.

You are proactive, analytical, and self-driven, with strong communication skills and the ability to build trust across all levels of the organization. Most importantly, you understand how to balance compliance requirements with practical business needs while maintaining a strong customer focus.

Social Events: We have a strong company culture that we invest heavily in maintaining and developing. This includes a wide range of events and an active employee association that organizes activities such as Friday bars, Christmas parties, an annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more!

Körber – Conquer Supply Chain Complexity

We value diversity and welcome all applicants, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, identity, or any other protected status.

jobs.occupation: Senior Network Specialist – Core Infrastructure Platforms
jobs.description:
Senior Network Specialist – Core Infrastructure Platforms

We are moving our entire network and firewall estate to an automated, code-driven operating model, and we need someone who can help lead that shift. If Ansible, Terraform and Git workflows excite you more than console access, this role is built for you.

**The job

**

You will help design, build and operate the automation platform behind our entire network and firewall estate, moving us from manual, device-by-device changes to a version-controlled, peer-reviewed, GitOps-style way of working. As a technical anchor in Core Infrastructure Platforms, you will shape how the whole Infrastructure department approaches network automation.

In short, you can look forward to:

•    Driving network automation – help architecting, building and maintaining network automation for our Cisco and Palo Alto estate, replacing manual configuration with automated deployments.

•    Owning our network Source of Truth – building and operating the authoritative, version-controlled model of our intended network state (think Nautobot or Infrahub).

•    Designing CI/CD and Git – setting up pull requests, automated checks and review-gated deployments, and running the platforms

•    Running core network and SDN infrastructure – owning and optimising our datacenter and enterprise network, including Software-Defined Networking

**Joining the team

**

You will join our Infrastructure department, a small team coving everything infrastructure related.  We are in the beginning   of an ambitious shift from manual device configuration to a Source of Truth-driven, GitOps-style operating model, and you will have real influence over the architecture, tooling and practices we adopt next.

You will also act as a sparring partner and mentor to colleagues across Infrastructure, sharing what you build through documentation and peer review so good ideas do not stay with just one person.

**Your qualifications

**

You have a solid networking foundation combined with hands-on experience in modern network automation. You are comfortable working across Cisco and Palo Alto platforms, treating infrastructure as code with tools such as Ansible or Terraform, building CI/CD pipelines and using Git. We are interested in the strengths you bring across the areas below. Your most important skills are:

•    Solid networking fundamentals (L2/L3, BGP, OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN) with hands-on experience in Cisco (IOS/NX-OS) and Palo Alto/Panorama, plus exposure to SDN paradigms such as Cisco ACI.

•    Hands-on experience with Ansible or Terraform applied to network infrastructure.

•    Experience designing or operating CI/CD pipelines and using Git

•    Scripting skills in Python or Jinja2, with comfort working with APIs.

On a personal level, you are a proactive team player who shares what you build, a problem solver with an eye for detail, and someone who would rather automate a problem away than solve it the same way twice.

Professional proficiency in English is required; Danish is an advantage.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Jesper Hougaard Andersen, Senior Manager, Core Infrastructure Platforms.
